newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks higher, Sun Micro strong.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks higher, Sun Micro strong.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed higher, buoyed by strength in some high techs, most notably a rally in shares of Sun Microsystems Inc.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 4.87 points, or 0.42 percent, at 1153.89 while advances led declining issues by 2135 to 1837 on volume of about 467 million shares.
Sun was up 2-5/8 at 56-3/8 after Alex. Brown raised its 1996 and 1997 calendar year and 1997 fiscal year earnings per share estimates for the company.
Also contributing to the strength in Nasdaq was a rally in shares of 3Com Corp on the heels of an announcement Tuesday that it was implementing major restructuring. The stock was up 2-3/8 at 48-3/8.
First Team Sports Inc was down 1-1/4 at 8-1/2, after forecasting a second quarter earnings shortfall.

CompuServe Corp was up 1-1/16 at 13-3/8. H&R Block said that its cancellation of a vote on spinning off its interest in the online service will alow it to explore other ways of disposing of the stake.
